newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Fire guts Asian workers' residence in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Fire guts Asian workers' residence in Bahrain.

text.p: Fire gutted an Asian workers' residence in a Bahraini village on Wednesday, causing damage but there were no reports of casualties, a government official said.
"Fire broke out at a foreign workers' residence in al-Daih on Wednesday. Four rooms have been damaged," the official told Reuters. He gave no further details.
Witnesses said firefighters were seen battling the blaze at the two-storey building in the Shi'ite village of al-Daih, five km (three miles) west of the capital Manama.

A series of arson attacks hit Bahrain, the Gulf's main financial and banking hub, in June and July in which six Asians died. Their death raised to 13 the number of Asians killed in the Gulf Arab state. Seven Bangladeshis died in a blaze in 1996.
